title: Makeup Expiry Queue by Month
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beauty:product product_name=* expiry_epoch=* status=*
| eval days_left=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where status!="discarded"
| table product_name category status days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open makeup products with time remaining for beauty inventory.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support beauty inventory.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `beauty:product` events and filter for open or unfinished makeup products.
visualization: Table of open makeup products sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which makeup products are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before beauty inventory slips.
